news.title: Upcoming Friday Clashes: Action Thriller Sigma Meets Supernatural Comedy DTTT
news.summary: Following a mixed box-office run for Nani's recent release The Paradise, audiences are eyeing the upcoming Friday theatrical arrivals. Sandeep Kishan's stylish action drama Sigma and Fahadh Faasil's supernatural venture Dont Trouble The Trouble are both gearing up for competitive multi-language releases. While Sigma aims to pull crowds across Telugu states and Tamil Nadu, DTTT looks to capture family audiences with its fantasy-infused storyline set in Hyderabad.

news.title: Ram Charan Starrer Peddi Locks Its Hindi Television Premiere Date
news.summary: Director Buchi Babu Sana's action drama Peddi, starring Ram Charan and Janhvi Kapoor, is heading to the small screen. Sony MAX has scheduled the official Hindi television premiere for October 25, 2026. Meanwhile, discussions regarding a potential Telugu television broadcast during the Dasara festival are currently underway.

news.title: Actor Allu Sirish Lodges Police Complaint Over Late-Night Loud Music
news.summary: Actor Allu Sirish reached out to the Hyderabad City Police via social media regarding persistent loud music continuing late into the night near his Shaikpet residence. Sirish stated that celebrations near a local temple had extended beyond permitted hours despite previous cooperation during festival periods. The Hyderabad City Police responded by forwarding his grievance to the Film Nagar Police Station for further evaluation.

news.title: Zarina Wahab Portrays a Moving Role in Puri Jagannadh's Slum Dog - 33 Temple Road
news.summary: The creators of Puri Jagannadh's upcoming pan-Indian project Slum Dog - 33 Temple Road have released a special promotional glimpse featuring veteran actor Zarina Wahab as Zubeidaa. The preview highlights an emotional narrative focusing on severe poverty and survival, backed by Harshavardhan Rameshwar's musical score. The film is jointly produced by Puri Jagannadh, Charmme Kaur, and JB Narayan Rao Kondrolla, featuring an ensemble cast that includes Samyuktha and Tabu.

news.title: Rag Mayur's Anumanam Pakshi Suffers Major Box Office Collapse
news.summary: The low-budget comedy-drama Anumanam Pakshi, starring Rag Mayur and marking the Telugu debut of actress Merin Philip, faced a disastrous opening following its September 25 release. Plagued by poor audience turnout with near-zero occupancy rates and heavily negative reviews targeting its writing and execution, the Chilaka Productions venture turned out to be a massive commercial failure.

news.title: Sandeep Reddy Vanga Backed Romanchakam Locks Netflix OTT Premiere Date
news.summary: The youthful romantic comedy Romanchakam is scheduled to arrive on Netflix on October 1, 2026. Directed by debutant Venu Gopal Reddy and starring Sumanth Prabhas alongside Ananthika Sanilkumar, the film is presented by Sandeep Reddy Vanga and produced by Pranay Reddy Vanga. Its upcoming digital release aims to find a broader appreciative audience after a modest theatrical run.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Dominates Nizam Box Office in Opening Weekend
news.summary: Srikanth Odela's directorial venture The Paradise has wrapped up its extended opening weekend with a stellar approximately Rs. 27.5 crore share in the Nizam territory. Despite encountering mixed to negative reviews, the SLV Cinemas production outperformed the critical reception to pull massive crowds. Trade analysts will now closely watch how the high-budget film fares during the crucial weekday business.

news.title: KTR Applauds Nani’s The Paradise Following Special Screening
news.summary: BRS working president K. T. Rama Rao attended a special screening of Nani's latest movie, The Paradise, in Hyderabad alongside several party leaders. He commended director Srikanth Odela and the cast for crafting a compelling narrative that highlights a community's fight against oppression through a distinct regional lens.

news.title: Zarina Wahab Steps Into Puri Jagannadh and Vijay Sethupathi's Slum Dog
news.summary: Veteran actress Zarina Wahab has been officially introduced as Zubaida in the upcoming pan-India action drama Slum Dog, directed by Puri Jagannadh. The project features Vijay Sethupathi in the lead role alongside a diverse ensemble cast and is slated for release across five languages.

news.title: The Vvaan Witnesses Growth in Box Office Numbers on Day Two
news.summary: Despite encountering an initial wave of negative reviews upon its Friday release, the supernatural folklore film starring Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia reportedly picked up pace on its second day. The production team claims the worldwide collections have reached ₹23.5 crore as word-of-mouth brings in more theatergoers.

news.title: Hanuman Ansh Crosses Massive Box Office Milestone on Day 52
news.summary: The small-budget feature Hanuman Ansh has emerged as a historic box office phenomenon, surpassing the ₹400 crore gross threshold in its 52nd theatrical day. Built on a modest budget and modest opening, the film continues its extraordinary long-run streak despite missing out on a local Telugu distribution deal.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Faces Crucial Weekday Box Office Test
news.summary: Despite facing harsh social media criticism and negative reviews, the Nani-starrer The Paradise has managed impressive box office collections, particularly in Telangana. Bolstered by an extended holiday weekend, the film is projected to comfortably surpass the ₹150 crore gross mark during its opening days. Trade experts note that the true evaluation of its box office strength will begin once regular working days resume.

news.title: First Single From Venkatesh and Trivikram's Aadarsha Kutumbam Unveiled
news.summary: The makers of Aadarsha Kutumbam House No.47 have released its energetic opening track titled Narayanamma, composed by Thaman S and penned by Ramajogayya Sastry. During the Hyderabad launch event, Venkatesh expressed his excitement about reuniting with Trivikram after two decades, while the director reflected on their long-standing professional bond. Scheduled to hit theatres globally on October 9, 2026, the project also features Srinidhi Shetty, Nivetha Pethuraj, and a special appearance by Dimple Hayathi.

news.title: Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt's Love & War Lands Unexpected OTT Deal
news.summary: Sanjay Leela Bhansali's upcoming period drama Love & War, featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal, has locked its digital partner ahead of its theatrical debut. Industry circles were surprised when ZEE5 acquired the streaming rights for approximately Rs 25 crore, a figure considered relatively modest given the star-studded cast and massive production scale. The big-budget venture is slated for a grand theatrical arrival on January 21, 2027.

news.title: Shared Responsibility in Film Success and Failure
news.summary: The outcome of any cinematic project is a collaborative effort rather than the burden of a single individual. From the director and actors to the technical crew and financiers, every department contributes to the final result on screen. Consequently, the entire film unit should equally share the credit for a blockbuster or the accountability for a disappointment.

news.title: Venkatesh's Aadarsha Kutumbam Launches Festive Single Narayanamma
news.summary: The musical promotions for Victory Venkatesh's family entertainer Aadarsha Kutumbam, also known as AK47, have commenced with the release of its first single, Narayanamma. Composed by Thaman S and featuring energetic vocals by Ram Miriyala and Prabha, the track highlights the dance moves of Dimple Hayati alongside the main cast. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas and produced by S. Radha Krishna, the movie is slated for a worldwide theatrical premiere on October 9, 2026.

news.title: Prabhas Unveils Gen-Z Centric Story Video for Romeo Juliet
news.summary: Leading actor Prabhas has launched the promotional story video for the upcoming youthful film Romeo Juliet, starring Harshit and Vishaka Dhiman. Directed by Bhargav Mucharla, the narrative offers a satirical look at modern dating trends, situationships, and digital-era heartbreak. The movie is scheduled to hit theaters on October 23, coinciding with Prabhas's birthday.

news.title: Prabhas Unveils the Story Glimpse for Gen Z Rom-Com Romeo Juliet
news.summary: Rebel Star Prabhas has launched the story reveal glimpse for the upcoming youthful romance Romeo Juliet, directed by Bhargav Macharla. The film stars Harshith and Vishaka Dhiman, focusing heavily on modern relationship terminology and contemporary romance struggles. Backed by Navarasa Entertainments, the movie is slated for theatrical release on October 23.

news.title: Venkatesh's Adarsha Kutumbam Drops Its First Single Narayanamma
news.summary: The promotional campaign for Venkatesh's upcoming family entertainer Adarsha Kutumbam has officially kicked off with the release of the track Narayanamma. Composed by Thaman, the lively dance number features Venkatesh alongside Dimple Hayathi, Sreenidhi Shetty, and Nivetha Pethuraj. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas, the movie is scheduled to hit the big screen on October 9.

news.title: Narayanamma Track from Venkatesh and Trivikram's Aadarsha Kutumbam Released
news.summary: Makers of the upcoming Telugu biggie Aadarsha Kutumbam have unveiled the film's first single titled Narayanamma. Composed by Thaman with vocals by Prabha Bangarigalla and Ram Miriyala, the song showcases energetic dance moves from Dimple Hayathi, Srinidhi Shetty, Nivetha Pethuraj, and lead actor Venkatesh. The family entertainer, directed by Trivikram Srinivas, heads to theatres on October 9.

news.title: Blockbuster Malayalam Hit Bethlehem Kudumba Sets JioHotstar OTT Date
news.summary: The Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju starrer Bethlehem Kudumba Unit (BKU), directed by Girish AD, has officially set its digital premiere on JioHotstar. Having shattered box office records as a massive industry hit, the rom-com will arrive on streaming in multiple languages, including Telugu, on October 2. Produced by Bhavana Studios, the film continues to draw audiences in cinemas even ahead of its digital debut.

news.title: Nivin Pauly's Bethlehem Kudumba Unit Locks OTT Date
news.summary: Following its successful theatrical run, the Malayalam romantic comedy drama Bethlehem Kudumba Unit is heading to its digital platform. Directed by Girish A.D. and starring Nivin Pauly alongside Mamitha Baiju, the movie is scheduled to premiere on JioHotstar. Trade reports indicate the film crossed strong box office collections during its cinema run.

news.title: Tamil Star Suriya Advises Supporters to Avoid Online Disputes
news.summary: Actor Suriya recently interacted with fan club members and urged them to steer clear of internet negativity and controversies. He advised his followers not to waste time answering critics, emphasizing the importance of focusing on personal work. Instead of engaging in disputes, the actor encouraged spreading positivity.

news.title: Anticipation Builds Around Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 Pre-Release Business
news.summary: Rajinikanth's upcoming sequel Jailer 2 carries massive pre-release business targets following the massive success of the first installment. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the film aims for high box office numbers as it prepares for an upcoming theatrical arrival. Trade analysts are watching to see if the project can push boundaries for regional cinema.

news.title: Rajinikanth and Kamal Haasan's Dharman Eyeing Festive Release
news.summary: The highly anticipated film Dharman, starring Rajinikanth and produced by Kamal Haasan, is currently under active production. Directed by Ashwath Marimuthu, the project features a notable cast including Telugu actor Ram Pothineni in an important role. The makers are currently targeting a theatrical release during the Pongal festival season.

news.title: Mahesh Babu's Next Venture Sparks Major Speculation
news.summary: As Mahesh Babu nears the completion of SS Rajamouli's Varanasi, rumors regarding his next directorial collaboration are heating up. While several filmmakers have been linked to the superstar, recent industry buzz has drawn attention toward Lokesh Kanagaraj. However, no official confirmation has been made regarding an actor-director partnership between the two.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Address Backlash Over Controversial Scene
news.summary: The team behind The Paradise has opened up about a heavily trolled dialogue involving Kayadu Lohar's character being called a single-take artist. Director Srikanth Odela explained that the line was intended to be ironic, but the crucial emotional backstory was trimmed for runtime. Lead actor Nani acknowledged that removing the setup ultimately led to the payoff being misunderstood by audiences.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Serves Striking Retro Looks in New Photoshoot
news.summary: Actor Taapsee Pannu has captivated fans with a bold new photoshoot featuring vintage-toned aesthetics and retro glamour. The actor, who has faced a challenging box office run recently with Advocate Raavi and Gandhari, continues filming for Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?. Her latest fashion statement highlights her characteristic fearlessness both on and off the screen.

news.title: NTR Set to Return for Next Schedule of Dragon
news.summary: Following a break due to a shoulder injury, actor NTR is gearing up to resume shooting for Prashanth Neel's directorial project Dragon. A high-voltage action sequence is slated to be filmed in Mumbai starting October 10. The big-budget venture, backed by Mythri Movie Makers and NTR Arts, also features an ensemble cast including Rukmini Vasanth and Anil Kapoor.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi’s January 12 Vidudala Nears Completion
news.summary: Director Anil Ravipudi is speeding through the final stages of his upcoming film, January 12 Vidudala, starring Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty. Following a brief pause, the team is set to film in Ooty and abroad before wrapping up shooting by mid-November. The movie features music by GV Prakash Kumar and is scheduled for a theatrical release on January 12th.
